description: This PHP source file defines the PricingClient class within the Aws\Pricing namespace. The class extends AwsClient and includes method annotations for interacting with the AWS Price List Service, such as describeServices, getAttributeValues, getPriceListFileUrl, getProducts, and listPriceLists, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: PricingClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Price List Service, providing methods to retrieve pricing information and service details.

methods.name: describeServices
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions of available AWS services.

methods.name: describeServicesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves descriptions of available AWS services.

methods.name: getAttributeValues
methods.description: Gets attribute values for AWS pricing.

methods.name: getAttributeValuesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously gets attribute values for AWS pricing.

methods.name: getPriceListFileUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for the AWS price list file.

methods.name: getPriceListFileUrlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the URL for the AWS price list file.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Fetches products from the AWS Price List Service.

methods.name: getProductsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches products from the AWS Price List Service.

methods.name: listPriceListsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists available AWS price lists.
